cohort: 803,249 deliveries at a military hospital, two university hospitals, a community hospital in South Carolina, and all community hospitals in Arkansas from January 1992 to December 2009
finding: Cesarean delivery rates increased across all practice models, with the lowest increase in the military hospital, while forceps deliveries decreased dramatically overall, especially in the military hospital.
mod_finding: The overall cesarean delivery rate has increased in all practice models but less so in the military, while forceps deliveries have dramatically decreased overall, especially in the military hospital.
